question: A coach wants the final energy of motion, in joules, of a cart after a 14 J push, before which a 28 J ramp and, earlier, a 3 J nudge added to its energy of motion. The cart has a mass of 41 kg. Its speed, in m/s, is the smaller root of x² - 5x + 4 = 0. What is the final energy of motion, in J?

A foreman wants the total force, in newtons, on 5 identical carts, each with 9 N of fan push added after 17 N of drag is removed from the force needed to accelerate its 94 kg mass. The carts are 1.5 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the number of ways to choose 2 wheels from 6. What is the total force, in N?

A 152 000 g crate is accelerated on a conveyor at a rate, in m/s², that is 19 more than 2 times the smaller root of x² - 9x + 14 = 0. The conveyor is 10 m long. The force for one crate is expressed in kilonewtons, and the plant runs 11 identical conveyors. What is the total force, in kN?

A club is compiling the total energy of motion, in kilojoules, of 4 sessions, each with 3 heats of 5 identical model karts, with each session's figure expressed in kilojoules. Each model kart has a mass of 42 000 g. Each kart's speed, in m/s, is the larger root of x² - 7x + 12 = 0. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ?

A 196 000 g elevator car is accelerated upward by its hoist, with gravity balanced by a counterweight. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 3x³ + 0·x² is itself changing at x = 3. The shaft is 80 m tall. The hoist force is expressed in kilonewtons, and 27 kN is added as a brake reserve. The building has 5 such cars, and the developer owns 11 identical buildings. What is the total rated hoist force, in kN, across all buildings?

A rail engineer wants the net energy figure, in kilojoules, for a test: it is the combined energy of motion of 8 identical model wagons, expressed in kilojoules, minus 18 kJ absorbed by the buffers, minus 22 kJ lost in the brakes. Each model wagon has a mass of 43 kg and is 1.5 m long. Each wagon's speed, in m/s, equals the area under the curve y = 2x² + 6x from x = 0 to x = 2. What is the net energy figure, in kJ?

A quarry wants the total force, in kilonewtons, for 5 pits, each with 8 identical loaders. Each loader's force is what accelerates its 193 000 g bucket, plus 14 N of hinge friction. The bucket's acceleration, in m/s², equals the rate at which the slope of the curve y = 5x³ + 1·x² is itself changing at x = 2. What is the total force, in kN?

A 44 kg sled moves along a rail at a speed, in m/s, equal to the area under the curve y = 5x² + 5x from x = 0 to x = 3. The rail is 60 m long. The sled's energy of motion is expressed in kilojoules; it then loses 21 kJ to a brake and 9 kJ to air drag. What energy of motion, in kJ, remains?

A physics teacher wants a final figure, in joules: 1 J stored in the launcher's latch, plus the combined energy of motion of 4 lanes of 12 identical 10 kg carts. The track is 6 m long. Each cart's speed, in m/s, is 8 times the greatest common divisor of 188 and 368. What is the final figure, in J?

A 60 000 g press ram moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the smaller root of x² - 15x + 56 = 0. The press operates at 220 bar. The press makes 12 strokes per part, and the per-part total of the ram's energy of motion is expressed in kilojoules. The shop makes 3 parts per shift and runs 11 shifts. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ, delivered over the 11 shifts?

A 118 000 g cart is accelerated on a test rail at a rate, in m/s², equal to the area under the curve y = 5x² + 6x from x = 1 to x = 3. The rail is 25 m long. The force is expressed in kilonewtons, and 16 kN is added as a safety margin. The rail has 4 identical carts, and a 21 kN reserve is added to the combined figure. What is the final rating, in kN?

A 147 kg hovercraft model is pushed forward on a test pond at an acceleration, in m/s², equal to 4 times the sum of 3 and 7. The pond is 30 m wide. The forward force is expressed in kilonewtons, and a 20 kN backward tether then acts on the model. The test runs 12 identical models. What is the net forward force, in kN, across all 12, with backward forces counted as negative?

A depot wants the rated force, in kilonewtons, for a wagon hoist: a 1 kN reserve plus the force to accelerate a 157 000 g wagon, expressed in kilonewtons. The acceleration, in m/s², is found by taking the slope of the curve y = 3x³ + 4x² at x = 1, multiplying it by 5, and subtracting 19. Gravity is balanced by a counterweight. What is the rated force, in kN?

A 73 kg crate is accelerated on a conveyor at a rate, in m/s², that is 24 more than 5 times the sum of 2 and 8. The plant runs 11 identical crates at once. A tailwind adds 27 N to the total force, and a slope removes 30 N. What is the total force, in N?

A 57 000 g mail cart rolls at a speed, in m/s, equal to the smaller root of x² - 8x + 7 = 0. The corridor is 30 m long. The post office runs 10 identical carts at once; the group loses 25 J of its energy of motion to a door threshold. The result is expressed in kilojoules, and a lift adds 10 kJ. What is the final energy figure, in kJ?

A depot wants the total force, in newtons, for 4 identical carts, each with 18 N of tailwind added after 1 N is recovered by a regenerative unit from the force needed to accelerate its 187 000 g mass. The acceleration, in m/s², is the slope of the curve y = 2x³ - 5x² at x = 2. What is the total force, in N?

A 108 kg robot is accelerated across a factory floor at a rate, in m/s², equal to the area under the curve y = 4x² + 4x from x = 0 to x = 1. A slope supplies 19 N of the force needed, and a cable adds 3 N of drag. The factory runs 6 identical robots per line and 9 lines. What total force, in N, must the drives supply?

A coach wants the combined energy figure, in kilojoules, of 2 identical sleds, each with 21 J added by a push to its energy of motion. Each sled has a mass of 35 kg. Each sled's speed, in m/s, equals the area under the curve y = 2x² + 3x from x = 1 to x = 4. What is the combined energy figure, in kJ?

A depot wants the total force, in newtons, for 10 lines of 7 identical 183 kg carts, less 23 N recovered by a shared regenerative rail. The carts are 2 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², is the greatest common divisor of 210 and 150. What is the total force, in N?

A lab wants a final figure, in kilonewtons: 11 kN from a clamp, plus 6 kN from a spring, plus the force to accelerate a 5 kg cart, expressed in kilonewtons. The cart's acceleration, in m/s², equals the area under the curve y = 1·x² + 1·x from x = 1 to x = 2. The cart runs on an air track. What is the final figure, in kN?

A depot wants the total force, in kilonewtons, for 6 identical lines. Each line's figure is the force for 9 identical 56 000 g carts, expressed in kilonewtons, plus 2 kN for the line's drive. The carts are 1.4 m long. The acceleration, in m/s², equals the number of ways to choose 2 wheels from 6. What is the total force, in kN?

A 169 kg cart is accelerated at a rate, in m/s², equal to 4 times the sum of 7 and 10. The cart is 1.8 m long. The depot runs 5 carts per line; each line's force is expressed in kilonewtons, and there are 10 lines. What is the total force, in kN?

A coach wants the total energy figure, in kilojoules, of 9 teams of 3 identical riders. Each rider's figure is the energy of motion of a 60 kg rider-and-bike, expressed in kilojoules, plus 17 kJ from a battery boost. The track is 250 m long. The speed, in m/s, is the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ + 2x² at x = 3. What is the total energy figure, in kJ?

A 19 kg cart on a lab bench moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the larger root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. It loses 27 J of its energy of motion to friction. The remainder is expressed in kilojoules, and a heater adds 30 kJ to the cart's energy account. What is the final energy figure, in kJ?

A 49 000 g model kart moves at a speed, in m/s, equal to the slope of the curve y = 3x³ + 1·x² at x = 1. A club runs 4 identical karts per heat and 4 heats per session, with the session total expressed in kilojoules. The club holds 4 sessions. What is the total energy of motion, in kJ?
